mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and falling UNRATE (signaling reduced labor market slack) jointly predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint behavior of PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to predict SPX returns with Rank IC > 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling weakening supply chain activity, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns following triggered INDPRO declines are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% month-over-month, indicating strong housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with RSAFS growth > 5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of FEDFUNDS, as a proxy for the monetary policy stance, inversely correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly inversely correlated with FEDFUNDS levels (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of PAYEMS and UNRATE, where both are rising, signals labor market overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint behavior of PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to predict SPX returns with Rank IC > 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 10% year-over-year, indicating robust housing demand, is regime-conditional, only positively influencing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of early-cycle expansion instances with HOUST growth > 10% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.
